instruction: Candid street photograph, medium wide shot. On an outdoor city sidewalk, three men reenact a pointing meme. The man with glasses and curly hair in a tan jacket (R3) stands on the left in profile, pointing right. The man with dark curly hair in a light brown jacket (R1) stands in the center background, pointing to both sides. The man with glasses and a dark brown jacket (R2) stands on the right in profile, pointing left. Natural overcast daylight illuminates the scene.
